source.notes: The Authorization header was redacted at capture time; the X-CSRF-Token header was redacted by the transcriber before this cassette was written (the underlying token was a real, session-scoped value, not a secret meant to be preserved). POST /sap/bc/adt/repository/nodestructure against SABP_UNIT_ADT with an empty body. Folder/type-group nodes in the response carry an empty <OBJECT_NAME/> and <OBJECT_URI/>; a reader must not treat every DEVC-prefixed OBJECT_TYPE as a navigable sub-package — only DEVC/K rows with a non-empty OBJECT_NAME are real sub-packages. This capture happens to contain no DEVC/K rows at all (no sub-packages under SABP_UNIT_ADT); see nodestructure-package-with-objects's sibling capture 853 for a DEVC/K example, which is not itself wired as a cassette here.
